panels.title: Manager RSS vs cap, warn and shed thresholds

panels.title: FUSE write buffer vs dirty cap

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_fuse_write_buffered_bytes" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "buffered")
  |> group(columns: ["node", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_fuse_write_dirty_cap_bytes" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "cap")
  |> group(columns: ["node", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_fuse_meta_cache_entries" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "entries")
  |> group(columns: ["node", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_fuse_write_cap_waits" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "waits/s")
  |> group(columns: ["node", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)

base = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_fuse_write_cap_wait_us" and (r._field == "p50" or r._field == "p90" or r._field == "p99"))
    |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "wait us " + r._field}))
    |> group(columns: ["node", "_field"])

lo = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /(p50|p90)$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
hi = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /p99$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

union(tables: [lo, hi])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_metrics_dropped_batches" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "dropped ")
  |> group(columns: ["node", "server", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
